test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can do a certain work in the same time that B and C together can do it. If A and B together could do it in 10 days and B alone in 25 days, then C alone could do it in:
solution:
**Given:**

(A + B) time = 10 days

B time = 25 days

A = (B + C)

**Formula Used:**

Work rate = 1 ÷ Time

A = B + C ⇒ Rate(A) = Rate(B) + Rate(C)

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 10 and 25 = 50

⇒ Rate (A + B) = 5 ÷ 50

⇒ Rate B = 2 ÷ 50

⇒ Rate A = Rate (A + B) − Rate B

⇒ Rate A = (5 ÷ 50) − (2 ÷ 50) = 3 ÷ 50

⇒ Rate A = Rate B + Rate C

⇒ 3 ÷ 50 = 2 ÷ 50 + Rate C

⇒ Rate C = (3 ÷ 50) − (2 ÷ 50) = 1 ÷ 50

⇒ Time of C = 50 days

**∴ The correct answer is 50 days.**
